snippet.title: Dancing with Ghosts - Official Trailer | Indie Fan Fest Fall 2025
snippet.description: Dancing With Ghosts is a cozy, wholesome narrative about a young teen girl who befriends a ghost that only she can see. Weighed down by the death of her parents, the girl finds healing through friendship, dance, and helping others. Dancing With Ghosts will be available on PC, and a Kickstarter campaign is coming soon.
